profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in Python, C++, Distributed Systems, Backend Infrastructure, Performance. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Engineering - MEng focused in Computer Science from Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Software Engineer working on Network Infrastructure Capacity Planning at Meta.

Recent work includes:
 - Reworking tedious manual workflows to be agent-driven - significantly reducing manual overhead and errors.
 - Collaborating across teams to develop capacity planning insights - leveraging fleet-wide insights to enable efficient rebalancing of resources.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm part of the D team; we focus on improving Google's global file system. In particular, my work focuses on improving the performance of Google's storage infrastructure.

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description: At BrainHi I helped implement product features as well as the supporting infrastructure. This included building out infrastructure on AWS and working with the Django Web Framework. I also led a project to create a background service running natively on client's computers which would keep their data in sync with our servers.

positions.title: Security Software Engineer
positions.description: My work focused on improving Airbnb's secrets management infrastructure. In addition, I focused on projects ensuring that new services were set up with smart and secure defaults. This effort helped improve developer speed since we managed to eliminate a portion of the time spent on configuring new services.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Cybersecurity research on Software Defined Networks in the context of defending against adaptive attackers and predicting future attacks by these types of adversaries.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Implemented features for better handling of maintenance tasks for Facebook’s backend sharded services

Improved performance through decrease of lock contention in tasks managing sharded services

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Worked on a yearlong project to develop tools in order to better extract information from unstructured data. Specifically, my project dealt with detecting faces within a video and using online image databases along with textual clues in the video in order to match identities to the faces detected.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on optimizing backend processes for Facebook's Graph Search infrastructure.

positions.title: Security Consulting Intern
positions.description: Researched web vulnerabilities within the NodeJS environment.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Implemented a secure search protocol on top of Gmail for the "private email" project at the Cyber Security REU program at the University of Maryland.

positions.title: Math for Computer Science (6.042) Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Lead a group of 6 to 8 students through daily in-class problem sets
- Grade and review preparation questions and weekly quizzes

positions.title: Teaching Assistant and Grader
positions.description: - Assisted online math classes on Pre-algebra, Geometry, Number Theory and Algebra

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented a real time AJAX data entry application 
- Worked on back-end features with data entry using PHP/MySQL
